physicalEvidence.summary: Full2025 paper executes an online adapting ResNet outer-loop controller at50Hz in ROS2 on a real Freefly Astro at UF AutonomyPark. It sends acceleration commands through MAVROS to a400Hz classicalPX4innerloop, following a15m×5m figure-eight at2.5m height for360seconds. This is actual learned physical control, not a web animation or a diffusion-policy study. Stability bounds hold under the paper’s assumptions; no general flight-safety guarantee inferred. Current LSU hardware availability is unknown; prior-UF collaboration is capped20.
